  "pros": [
    "Significantly improved reporting and visualization over Excel.",
    "Ability to consolidate various property data sources for analysis.",
    "Cost-effective solution for a small business."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Steep learning curve for data modeling and DAX queries coming from Excel.",
    "Can be challenging to implement complex reports without dedicated IT support.",
    "Occasional performance issues with larger datasets."
  ],
  "overall_experience": "This Property Administrator likely found Power BI to be a powerful upgrade from Excel for their reporting tasks, appreciating its enhanced visualization and data consolidation capabilities. While the initial learning curve for data modeling and advanced features might have presented challenges, especially without dedicated IT support in a small company, the value for money and improved insights into commercial real estate operations likely made it a worthwhile investment over their 1-2 years of use."
